messages:
Maria (CSM): Hey team — kicking off Curie Health onboarding. Quick sync on stakeholders, success criteria, and a 30/60/90-style timeline. @Priya @Liam @Anna @Ben — who can own which pieces? Deck: https://redwood.app/curie-onboard-deck

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can own integrations + API keys. Need dev access from Curie by Mon so we can spin up staging. Who's our contact at Curie?

Maria (CSM): Contact is Eliza Park (Dir Product) — I will intro by EOD. Proposed success criteria: 1) API integrated in staging, 2) 1k test queries with P50 < 200ms, 3) enablement session for product + support. Open to edits.

Liam (Customer Eng): I'll own perf benchmarks / SLOs. For the latency goal we need expected payload sizes and sample prompts. @Maria can you drop the samples here?

Anna (Product): Product will run acceptance tests and validate analytics events. I can coordinate the acceptance test plan and share event schema requirements.

Ben (Customer Success Lead): I'll track renewal-risk signals and build the health dashboard. Quick question — what go-live target are we aiming for? 45 days from kickoff ok?

Maria (CSM): Prefer D+45 as target. Draft timeline below — please call out any blockers to owning these dates:

```
D+0: kickoff & intros
D+7: staging API keys + sample prompts
D+21: end-to-end staging test (inc. perf run)
D+30: pilot w/ 1k queries
D+45: go-live
```

Can folks commit to D+7 and D+21 owners?

Priya (Solutions Eng): Yes, D+7 is good — I'll request access and post creds to the secure channel once we have them.

Liam (Customer Eng): D+21 works — I'll produce the perf report and recommendations (batching, quant settings) by then.

OnboardBot: Reminder: please upload kickoff notes to /onboard/curie within 24h. Meeting scheduled: 2026-04-10 16:00 UTC (calendar invite sent).

Maria (CSM): Thanks. Quick recap of action owners: (Maria) intro + deck, (Priya) staging creds D+7, (Liam) perf report D+21, (Anna) acceptance tests & analytics, (Ben) health dashboard. If no objections by tomorrow I will send the invite + runbook.

Ben (Customer Success Lead): I'll create the health dashboard template and share by Tue.

Priya (Solutions Eng): :thumbsup: I'll also coordinate with DevOps to whitelist Curie's test IPs.

Liam (Customer Eng): No objections from me. +1

Priya (Solutions Eng): All good on my end.

Maria (CSM): Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll post the intro thread to Eliza and move notes into the onboard folder after the intro.
